carla_customer: Hey team — after our IdP certificate rotation at 02:58Z a subset of users started getting 403s on SSO. Ticket SUP-20102. SAML errors: Recipient mismatch and Signature verification failed. We rolled the cert back at the IdP but failures persisted.

elena_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the decoded SAML response and confirm the ACS URL you have configured? Also which CDN/edge are you fronting with?

carla_customer: Decoded assertion (sanitized):
<Assertion ...>
  <Subject>
    <SubjectConfirmation>
      <SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://app.cust-example.com/sso/acs/"/>
    </SubjectConfirmation>
  </Subject>
  <Signature>...thumbprint: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF...</Signature>
</Assertion>
Our SP ACS is https://app.cust-example.com/sso/acs (no trailing slash). We're on EdgeWave CDN which normalizes origin paths and strips trailing slashes on pass-through.

elena_support: That Recipient has a trailing slash but your SP ACS doesn't — that causes recipient_mismatch. Also our active tenant metadata shows a different signing thumbprint. I'll pull the metadata our watcher has for your tenant.

bot-metadata: metadata-watcher|tenant=cust-example polled https://idp.cust-idp.net/metadata at 2026-03-16T03:05:13Z status=200 size=8.4KB etag="r3"

bot-metadata: metadata-watcher|tenant=cust-example validation WARN: XML appears truncated (missing closing token) — not promoted; active metadata unchanged

sre_sam: Tagging @alex_idp @nick_eng — watcher logged an HTTP 200 but response body was cut short. Auth logs show some assertions signed with a new cert thumbprint. Hypothesis: IdP performed a rolling key switch; some nodes signed with new key while their metadata endpoint returned incomplete/cached fragment missing the new KeyDescriptor.

alex_idp: That matches. If the IdP LB returned a partial response or an upstream proxy terminated the stream, our poller could see incomplete XML while users hit other IdP nodes that already signed with the new cert. Intermittent 502/504 from their LB would support this.

ce_jenna: Observed failure rate ~5-8% between 03:00Z–03:40Z. Errors captured: `SAML_ERROR recipient_mismatch expected=https://app.cust-example.com/sso/acs got=https://app.cust-example.com/sso/acs/` and `SAML_ERROR signature_invalid thumbprint mismatch`.

elena_support: Repro steps for us to validate: 1) From watcher host: `curl -v https://idp.cust-idp.net/metadata -o /tmp/metadata.xml && wc -c /tmp/metadata.xml` 2) Check `/var/log/metadata-watcher.log` for Content-Length/ETag values and parse errors 3) If possible, request IdP ops to query different nodes behind their LB to compare KeyDescriptor sets.

carla_customer: We ran curl from their LB subnet and got HTTP 200 but the file is smaller than expected and ends at `</EntityDescriptor` (no closing `>`). We also saw occasional 502/504 from the IdP LB around the same window.

sre_sam: Short-term mitigations: 
- enable tenant flag `sso.lenient_recipient=true` to allow trailing-slash normalization for 72h while the IdP stabilizes.
- ask customer to add an ACS alias `https://app.cust-example.com/sso/acs/` in their SP configuration to accept both variants.
Mid-term: engineering to harden metadata-watcher to validate full XML (ensure terminal `</EntityDescriptor>`), check Content-Length/ETag consistency, and ensure X509 intermediate chain is present before promoting new metadata.

nick_eng: I'll open a PR to add content-length + checksum checks and require chain validation before swap. ETA: canary deploy ~2.5h. I'll also add alerting on partial XML parse errors.

elena_support: Internal manual refresh endpoint (for operations):
POST https://console.internal.redwood/api/idp/metadata/refresh
body: { "tenant": "cust-example", "force": true }
We'll trigger this once IdP confirms they are serving full metadata.

carla_customer: Please run the manual refresh and enable the lenient flag. We'll patch our SP to include the trailing-slash alias as well.

bot-metadata: metadata-watcher|manual-refresh tenant=cust-example started by elena_support at 2026-03-16T05:12:02Z

bot-metadata: metadata-watcher|manual-refresh tenant=cust-example fetch status=200 size=20.9KB validation=PASS keys=[old:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF,new:11:22:33:44:55:66]

sre_sam: Verified new metadata includes both KeyDescriptors and the intermediate certificate chain. Nick's watcher improvements should help prevent promotion of truncated feeds.

elena_support: Enabled `sso.lenient_recipient` for cust-example for 72h. Ticket SUP-20102 updated with workaround steps, timeline, and follow-ups.

carla_customer: Confirming login success rate has returned to baseline. Thanks all — we'll keep the ACS alias for now and will coordinate removing it once you confirm the lenient flag is off.

nick_eng: Patch merged to main and rolling to canary; added alert for XML truncation and missing chain.

elena_support: We'll keep the ticket open until canary is stable and the temporary flag is removed. Postmortem items: recommend IdP sticky sessions, verify origin doesn't truncate responses, and document ACS alias guidance in SSO troubleshooting docs.

carla_customer: Thanks everyone, leaving ticket open until after the canary run and flag removal. :thumbsup:
